notes.title: Roadmap & Price change
notes.content:
It's been a long time since the last living sign. I had lots of things to do with my private life but here we go again, time for some Updates!

[h1]Pricing[/h1]
To prevent future Cheaters from returning to the game and to support the cost of the servers, we will change the price for the game to 19,99$. We also plan on doing sales in the future. If you already have played the game, you are keeping it for free but your public steam review might not be that valuable.

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
Since the Roadmap was made for 2024, we already completed some of the steps. Due to private stuff I didn't completed the Roadmap as expected. The Priorities are mostly the same. I am first refactoring some parts since the server had some issues and I do not want to restart the server every day. With the new structure, Updates will be way faster for me.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42238199/f39fdddecdb57415d50f623d6b7e457e17eca0c1.png[/img]

[h1]Next Update[/h1]
The next Update will be the update to the new server and lots of backend stuff changed, not much notable except a more stable version. Its also starting back at version 0.0.2 since the game has lots of tasks to do since we can call it "officially completed". I have lots of time in the next months so I am confident, that we can get the game this year almost completed. There is no time for the next Update but it will be released without much more announcements.

Hope you are still on the Hype Train for this Year,
~ Blu

notes.title: v0.7.1 Arrived with huge improvements!
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]
- An issue was fixed, where some people could not see each other if they are in different countries, where the "," and the "." both used differently as seperator of decimal numbers.
- The ChatBox Paddock UI was reworked
- Some Issues in Team Management, Equipment Selection have been fixed
- TeamChat was added
- Local Chat History was added
- Time trial has been added to the Create Race Menu
- Paddock Selection was added to the ChatBox in the bottom left
- An Image for the Race Arena has been added
- Some buttons in the Paddock were updated visually and now toggle the respective window instead of only opening it


[h1]Notes for this Update[/h1]
The Team-Chat can be accessed in the Teamchat Tab. The Team-Chat is private to your Team. Only Staff can read the Chat to check for suspicous behavior and special support cases
The History will now be saved locally. You still receive messages when you are in the race and they will be displayed once you join back to a paddock. All Paddocks share the same Paddock Chat to allow cross-communication
Time Trials have unlimited laps, start with no timer on the beginning, is Solo only & starts on the last corner of the track

notes.title: Race Arena Update
notes.content:
In this Update we have added the Race Arena. We also adjusted the drifting speed boost so you are a bit faster. We also reset the current global leaderboard so its fair because of the recent changes to the driving.

The Race Arena is a place where you can drive for placing on the top 3 to receive a special jacket with a duration of 2h. The Race Arena resets each hour and changes the track.

Wish you best of luck in winning one of these jackets!

notes.title: v0.5.3 - Bug Fixes & new Minimap Type
notes.content:
With the Version 0.5.3 we have fixed several bugs and added a new minimap type.

[h1]Different MiniMap Types[/h1]

Settings:

[h1]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
- Settings screen size & refresh rate text are now displayed correctly
- Minimap had sometimes colors on the road. This issue is now fixed.
- Team Invites are now able to be accepted
- Team Promote, Demote, Kick & Leave is now working correctly
- Race Invitation Popup is now properly showing up
- The Car of a player is now removed from the Race when leaving the Game or returning to the Paddock
- The Create Race Menu showed every other player in the Paddock as "Player01". This issue is now fixed and shows the correct player name
- server stability is now a bit better
- laps selection was changed from 1,3,6,12,15,20,25,30 -> 1,3,10,15,20,25,30
- laps selection dropdown menu has now an increased height so the scrollbar is invisible for people who often plays on higher amount of laps

[h1]Next Major Update[/h1]
The next major Update will add a new Race Arena. Some parts of it can be already seen in the Paddock but are disabled until it is fully completed. More on that in a seperate Information Post.

notes.title: Migration Update v0.5.0
notes.content:
Hey!

We was working on the Migration and some other preperations for the next big Update. Since we are forced to migrate all accounts, its better to have it up front so in the meantime you can create your account again. In this Update are mostly invisible Changes you will probably not notice. We have also added a new Board where you can see the basic controls if you are new to the game.

[h1]Whats Planned for the next big Update?[/h1]
We have lots of plans for the next big Update. At the top of the priority list are the long-term features such as leveling system, divisions/rankings to see who is the real fastest driver of all. There will be also some Clothes you can buy on a Shop to not look like a complete beginner ;)
The Clothes can be bought with ingame currency, that you obtain by just driving. There will be more options to receive those currency/currencies. And last but not least are some graphic improvements. A brand new Design that will look amazing. You probably saw already some screenshots. There are more on our discord ;)

For now [b]there is no ETA[/b] on the Update since we want to make sure that it will be amazing!

[h1]What is the "Migration"?[/h1]
As a part of this Update we was forced to move to our own in-house solution to save & handle the Accounts. The previous Solution had some problems with scaling and was generally too limited. This is the last account deletion as we now have full control over accounts and can copy them over in case we want to switch later on.

But now for the good news: Your Clothes are saved! In case you won any cosmetics, you can claim them again on your new account by contacting our support on the discord.

[h1]Community Event[/h1]
Everyone who creates an Account until [b]15.03.2023[/b] will receive a unique Community Jacket!
It will be automatically equipped but you can equip the beginner Jacket if you prefer that by clicking on your name.

notes.title: Current Progress Information #2
notes.content:
Hey!

It's a long time ago since our last official Information on Steam. While we are still informing players on the official discord, we sometimes miss that the Steam Community should also know what is currently going on. So i will break down everything relevant.

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
We are now starting a Q&A. You can ask any question you have about the project, the future and other Game related stuff. You can write your Questions in Discord in the specific Q&A Channel or directly under this Post. Multiple Questions are also allowed. In the next Week I will Post here on Steam all the Questions & Answers so you can read through it.

[h1]What are we currently working on[/h1]
We are working on a very big migration for the version 0.5.0 which includes a lot of stuff like shops to buy clothes, level system to progress while driving, a huge new backend system (which requires all player accounts to be resetted) and other optimizations such as performance, UI and QoL Things. This will take some more time but its closer than you think. There is no release date yet but it could be there in a month.

notes.title: Update 0.4.5
notes.content:
Hey!

Here are the changes that came with this version:

- optimized server
- removed lag in paddock and race
- reduced the timer when someone was invited from 30 -> 15

We have noticed some stability issues and have fixed most of them now. In summary the game feels less laggy now.

For more details you can join our Discord: [b]discord.phantom-racing.com[/b]

In the upcoming updates we will implement an option to change the graphic settings so the game will run on low-end devices without a problem.
Also the first Grand Prix is on the way and will arrive in the coming weeks. Keep an eye on this patchnotes.
